title: Quartic Fourier-Laplace limits for $(p,q)$-Rogers-Szegő polynomials
summary: We prove asymptotic formulae for $(p,q)$-Rogers--Szegő polynomials with positive real parameters when the leading quadratic term in the logarithmic expansion about the middle coefficient vanishes. For coefficient indices whose distance from $n/2$ is of order $n^{3/4}$, the coefficient ratios have a quadratic--quartic exponential limit. A uniform bound valid for all indices allows the ratios to be summed and gives locally uniform convergence of the centred and normalised generating polynomials to a Fourier--Laplace integral.
